Admonitions: Get rid of MD_LINE_ADMONITIONTAG.

It has for all processing essentially the same meaning as MD_LINE_BLANK.
This also addresses the issue #334 as the special MD_LINE_ADMONITIONTAG
handling didn't ensure the previous block processing has been ended
properly if there was no preceding blank line.
